newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK to deploy 1,600 special police on handover night.
newsitem.headline: HK to deploy 1,600 special police on handover night.

text.p: At least 1,600 special police will be on patrol during the evening of June 30, 1997, to make sure one of Hong Kong's most historic events passes without a ripple, a senior police officer was quoted as saying on Tuesday.

Hong Kong returns to China at midnight on June 30, ending more than 150 years as a British colony. Thousands of foreign dignitaries, journalists and tourists are expected to mark the historical transfer of sovereignty.

Assistant Police Commissioner Dick Lee told a legislative panel on Monday that 1,600 officers of the tactical unit, which specialises in crowd control, would be on duty to cope with any emergencies around midnight on June 30, the Apple Daily newspaper reported.
